artifacts.note: Congressional Research Service report 97-1011, Salaries of Members of Congress: Recent Actions and Historical Tables, as mirrored by EveryCRSReport.com (dateModified 2026). States that Members' salary has been $174,000 since January 2009 and that adjustments have been denied through P.L. 119-37 (November 12, 2025).

rights.reason: CRS reports are generally public domain, but this copy is the third-party EveryCRSReport.com mirror, whose own terms are not recorded. Re-source from congress.gov (research, not decided here).
